responsibilities.quote: This Policy establishes Aston University’s commitment to fostering cutting-edge AI innovation while ensuring the ethical, safe, and privacy-preserving adoption and use of AI across all University activities.
Protect Rights and Privacy: Adhere to data protection, privacy, and intellectual property laws.
All AI projects require an AI Risk Assessment; Medium/High risk mandates Data Privacy Impact Assessment and Ethics review.
Business Owners complete AI Risk and Data Privacy Impact Assessments
Reviews and approves new AI initiatives.
Maintain human oversight; AI is an augmentation tool, not a replacement for professional judgment.
Report AI-related incidents to Legal Services and Data Protection team; follow the University’s incident response plan
All staff and students working with AI must complete the University’s Ethical AI and Data Protection e-module.
Continuous Learning: Quarterly workshops, webinars, and resources via the AI Accelerator and Digital Services.
Annual policy review (or earlier upon material changes in law or technology).
Design AI systems to be inclusive and usable by people of all abilities.
